title: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon worldwide
friendlyTitle: Google’s Gemini 4 Argon is now widely available
summary: Google has made Gemini 4 Argon available through its API, AI Studio, Gemini platform, Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity, with access varying by product and plan. Introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until November 30, after which Google says both rates will double.
friendlySummary: Google has released Gemini 4 Argon across developer and consumer products. Its lower launch price ends after November 30, when the listed API price will double.
whyItMatters: Argon is positioned for long, multi-step work across coding, finance, legal, cybersecurity and science rather than quick chat alone. Developers evaluating it should separate launch-period pricing from steady-state cost and test Google’s performance claims on their own workflows.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The model is designed for difficult, multi-step work. Test it on your real tasks and calculate the later price before building around it.
